blocks.html: Total Contract Value (TCV) is the total revenue a business expects to earn from a customer contract over its entire duration, including recurring fees, one-time charges, and add-on services.
TCV is an important sales and finance metric used to measure the full value of customer agreements. It helps businesses understand deal size, forecast revenue, and compare contract opportunities.
It is commonly used in SaaS, enterprise sales, and long-term service agreements.
A three-year software contract worth $20,000 annually plus a $5,000 setup fee has a TCV of $65,000.
Total Contract Value (TCV) is the complete revenue value of a customer contract across its full term.
Maximize contract profitability with smarter sales strategies. MarketJoy helps businesses improve TCV through better deal structuring and revenue planning.
